notes.subject: נעם
notes.rationale: 'olgutpela pasin' (favor/graciousness), 'hatwok pasin' (beauty), o 'switpela pasin' (pleasantness) — ol tanima i no wankain

notes.subject: na wantaim olgeta olsem
notes.rationale: ויהי long hia em i jussive (askim bilong God), Tok Pisin i nidim help tok bilong klia

notes.subject: ומעשה ידינו כוננה
notes.rationale: Tupela taim olsem wanpela — pasin bilong singaut i kamap strong, Hebrew i ripitim liklik senis tasol (כוננה / כוננהו)

translation: Na wantaim olgeta olsem, olgutpela pasin bilong Adonai Elohim bilong yumi i stap antap long yumi, na wok bilong ol han bilong yumi — em i ken strong long yumi, na wok bilong ol han bilong yumi — em i ken strongim em.

tokens.gloss: na wantaim em i ken kamap
